# 1957 Soviet Cup (Football)

The 1957 Soviet Cup was the 16th edition of the knockout football competition in the Soviet Union.

## Winner
**Lokomotiv Moscow** won the tournament, claiming their first Soviet Cup title.

## Final
The final was held in Moscow. Lokomotiv Moscow defeated **Spartak Moscow** to claim the trophy.

## Notable Points
- This was a significant achievement for Lokomotiv, as they secured their first major trophy in this competition
- Spartak Moscow, one of the dominant clubs of Soviet football, finished as runners-up
- The competition followed the traditional single-elimination knockout format used in Soviet football

## Context
The Soviet Cup ran alongside the Soviet Top League and was one of the two major domestic football competitions in the USSR. The 1957 edition took place during a period when Soviet football was developing strongly, just a year after the Soviet national team won gold at the 1956 Melbourne Olympics.
